visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short black hair and a black-and-white checkered jacket sits indoors against a plain wall, gesturing with his hands while speaking animatedly to the camera. (2) A woman wearing a pink hospital gown, a matching hairnet, and glasses appears in a bright hospital hallway; she covers her mouth with both hands in a surprised gesture and then adjusts her glasses while looking at the camera. (3) The man reappears in a blue hospital gown and a green medical hairnet, standing in a brightly lit corridor and smiling nervously while looking around. (4) The man is shown at eye-level in a bathroom with a circular mirror, washing his face vigorously with his hands while still dressed in his medical gown. (5) In a starkly lit operating room, the man lies on a surgical bed looking upward with a mix of curiosity and anxiety as medical equipment and staff are visible in the background. (6) A medical mask is placed over his face, and he blinks as he prepares for anesthesia; his eyes wander slightly before closing. (7) A very fast montage shows flickering scenes of the surgical environment and prep work. (8) Post-surgery, the man sits in a hospital bed looking extremely groggy and dazed with his eyes half-closed; he wears the same blue gown, and his hair is disheveled as he attempts to speak.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male vocal speech begins with an upbeat, rhythmic electronic BGM bed. The speaker's tone is casual and slightly fast-paced. (2) A sharp whoosh SFX marks a transition to a female voice laughing and expressing surprise with high pitch and arousal. (3) A sequence of metallic clicks and fabric rustling sounds are heard as the speaker prepares. (4) A short, bright ding SFX occurs as the male speaker continues his narration, which now sounds slightly more tense. (5) Cartoon-style laughter SFX (meme laughter) is heard under the male voice as he jokes with others. (6) The sound of a percussive impact SFX occurs as a scene changes to the operating room; ambient room tone shifts to a hollower hospital acoustic. (7) A deeper male voice with a professional tone speaks instructions followed by the soft hiss of air through a mask. (8) A fast-motion glitch SFX and rapid electronic tones play during a visual montage. (9) The audio energy drops significantly as the male voice returns sounding extremely breathy, slow, and low-pitched, accompanied by a soft female voice whispering comfort.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents the creator's personal journey of undergoing his third orthognathic (jaw) surgery. It aims to share the emotional arc from pre-surgery excitement and nerves to the vulnerable, groggy state immediately following the procedure, likely for engagement and empathy from his audience.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively uses fast-paced editing and social media-style overlays to lighten the mood of a serious medical procedure. The stark contrast between the high-energy beginning and the low-energy post-op ending creates a strong narrative impact.
